annotations.title: List free times for a call with a lead

description:
[read-only] The next free times on the brand's connected Google or Microsoft calendar for a call with one lead, under the brand's booking rules (length, buffers, hours). Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/leads/{leadId}/booking-slots.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands). Required for an account-wide key; a brand-bound key is pinned to its brand and any other value is 403.
